integrity: This package contains proofs and reproducible finite checks; references distinguish inspected papers from abstract-only and bibliographic background.
scientific_limitations: Results apply to full transitive strict-order relation of finite interval orders, not Hasse cover arcs.
Counting-logic isomorphism identification is relative to the finite interval-order class, not arbitrary strict posets.
Finite enumerations corroborate, but do not replace, all-cardinality proofs.
Core nested-neighborhood and Fishburn-matrix bijections are previously published; the claimed contributions concern joint-degree and one-sided fiber information and rank-two logic.
An associated published paper on enumerations of interval-order subclasses could be examined only through its abstract; specialized earlier coverage cannot be excluded.
Independent validation and publication-priority certification have not been performed.
title: Degree-pair reconstruction and Catalan margin fibers of finite interval orders
